units.source_text: 我并不是带着欣喜的心请听取这个消息的，

en.t: I did not receive this news with a joyful heart,

units.source_text: 迄今我故意省笔不提有关母亲的事，这是有其原因的。

en.t: Up to now, I have deliberately avoided writing about my mother, and there was a reason for that.

units.source_text: 因为我打心眼里不想触及母亲的事情。

en.t: Because, from the bottom of my heart, I did not want to touch on anything concerning my mother.
